description: Verify that TCP moves to CLOSED after receiving an ACK of the sent FIN in LAST-ACK (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
The last leg of the passive-close path: LAST-ACK → CLOSED on the peer's ACK. Verifies socket cleanup, exposed by a follow-up probe that should now elicit a RST (port has no live socket).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake; tester sends FIN; DUT enters CLOSE-WAIT; user CLOSE → DUT emits FIN, enters LAST-ACK.
2. Tester → DUT: ACK of DUT's FIN → DUT must reach CLOSED.
3. Tester → DUT: probe segment.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST (CLOSED-state response)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT emits RST to the post-CLOSE probe (proves cleanup happened).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_fin — no DUT FIN into LAST-ACK
• Fail_timeout_rst — no DUT RST from CLOSED

verdicts.Pass: DUT cleaned up to CLOSED — normal
